provenance.reference: PostgreSQL 18.4 (Debian 18.4-1.pgdg13+1) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit
provenance.method: Three libpq sessions in a disposable database. B completed DROP SERVER successfully before A COMMIT, confirmed by PQisBusy/PQgetResult; no timing threshold establishes completion. Before and after same-name server recreation, separate new connections captured the references and query errors. memory_fdw is a disposable wrapper without a handler.
provenance.normalization: Only the original server OID and its occurrence in error messages become $server_oid; the independently allocated replacement OID becomes $replacement_server_oid. The two captured OIDs differ. reference_only marks PostgreSQL-only setup or pg_foreign_table/pg_foreign_server introspection.

setup.sql: CREATE SERVER competing TYPE 'original' FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER memory_fdw

session_a.sql: CREATE FOREIGN TABLE ds414_orphan.remote(a integer) SERVER competing OPTIONS(source 'memory')

reference_before_recreate.sql: SELECT c.relname,f.ftserver::text,s.srvname,s.oid IS NULL AS missing_server FROM pg_foreign_table f JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=f.ftrelid LEFT JOIN pg_foreign_server s ON s.oid=f.ftserver WHERE c.relnamespace='ds414_orphan'::regnamespace ORDER BY c.relname
